bindings.reason: Task 3.3 replaces the page header with <UiSectionHeader>, whose default level is h2. The view's title is the /analyze route's only <h1>, and the axe baseline for that route has no page-has-heading-one entry -- dropping to h2 would add a new rule and fail the a11y gate. as="h1" keeps the document outline the baseline was recorded against; it picks a heading tag and nothing else.
